Leader line distance constraint violations (Q23, Q24): Callout Badges 1-4 had leader lines of length 38px, violating the [48, 80] px bounds defined in zoom_config_json; adjusted badge Y to 24px (leader length 52px) adhering to the bounds and maintaining >= 12px margin.
Canvas typography legibility (Q25): Upgraded sub-9px text (8px CRT labels and meter dial ticks) to 9px font for legibility and high contrast on dark #090d16 canvas.
Preserved live telemetry MathML units: Updated publishTelemetry to update firstElementChild directly, preventing destruction of child MathML unit elements.
Raw LaTeX and unparsed notation in principles_summary_html: Replaced unparsed powers and raw LaTeX 'A^(-1)', 'x^(0)', and '|lambda_n / lambda_(n-1)| < 1' with valid semantic MathML.
Unclosed HTML tags in principles_list_html: Appended missing closing tags (, , ) to the equation symbols container.
Unparsed powers and symbols in procedure_section_html: Converted raw 'A^(-1)', 'x(0) = [1, 1]^T', and 'x' in Steps 3, 4, and 5 into valid inline MathML.
Corrupted data-unit attributes in readouts_html: Sanitized unescaped nested HTML span tags inside data-unit attributes across all live readout elements to clean plain text 'dimensionless'.
Unwired action button: '#btn_launch_collision' was not queried in the launch button lookup, preventing the simulation from starting when clicking 'Launch Incident Disc'.
Unwired stepper buttons: Stepper up/down buttons ('.stepper-btn') were not wired to increment or decrement the parameter inputs.

Observation table column misalignment: btnRecord injected 8 table cells with an unindexed 'rowIdx' column instead of the 7 columns defined in observation_thead_html, misaligning velocities and energies.
Unwired MCB action button (btn_toggle_mcb): added state toggling, lever animation (I-ON/O-OFF), load bank disconnection, and no-load physics handling
Unwired stepper buttons: attached click event listeners to .stepper-btn to increment and decrement the active lamp load control
Misaligned observation table columns: removed extraneous serial number td from row creation so the 5 recorded cells align with the 5 observation table header columns
Low-contrast wires and terminal on dark #090d16 canvas: replaced invisible #0f172a return wires and #1e293b generator terminal with high-contrast #38bdf8

Misaligned observation table columns: btnRecord generated rows with only 7 columns containing shifted indices and concatenated dimensions instead of the 9 columns specified in observation_thead_html; corrected to populate Orifice Setting, Duct Width, Duct Height, Equivalent Diameter, Mean Velocity, Flow Rate, Pressure Difference, Resistance Coefficient, and Frictional Coefficient.

Unwired action buttons: 'btn_zero_manometer' and 'btn_traverse_anemometer' had no click event listeners in canvas_js; wired zero-balancing for minimeter/manometer levels and multi-point velocity traverse sampling.

Unwired stepper buttons: '.stepper-btn-up' and '.stepper-btn-down' buttons were not wired to update target inputs; added universal stepper click handlers respecting input min, max, step, and firing reactive change/input events.

Mismatched apparatus badge numbering: Reordered legend pills in legend_pills_html to match apparatus list and canvas badge callouts 1-to-1 (1: Analog Ammeter, 2: Analog Voltmeter, 3: Electrodynamometer Wattmeter, 4: Step-Down Transformer, 5: Electric Induction Motor).
Fixed broken MathML fraction rendering in transformer specification inside apparatus_html (replaced \frac{V}{115} with 230 V / 115 V).
Cleaned malformed data-unit attributes containing unescaped nested tags and quotes in readouts_html to standard units.

Observation table column misalignment: Replaced 8-column row generation in canvas_js with 6 columns properly matching observation_thead_html (Primary Voltage, Secondary Voltage, Circuit Current, Active Power, Brake Torque, Power Factor) and wired reset button (#btnReset).
Unwired action buttons: Connected #btn_energize_circuit and #btn_zero_calibrate in canvas_js to dynamically toggle circuit breaker state and reset/calibrate analog pointer deflections.
Unwired stepper controls: Stepper buttons (.stepper-btn-up and .stepper-btn-down) were wired in canvas_js, and getControlVal was clamped to [min, max] ranges to prevent crash edge-cases.
Wired top panel Pause/Run control (#btnToggle) and locked direct canvas pointer events.

Observation table columns in canvas_js recorded values in a scrambled order that did not match observation_thead_html (Va was placed in If column, IL in Va column, If in Ia column, N in IL column, Ia in N column, Pcore in Torque column, and T in Pcore column).
Telemetry readout elements in canvas_js were queried using 'reading_*' instead of 'val_reading_*', causing null references and preventing live readout values from updating.
Action button 'btn_toggle_dpst' (Toggle DPST Main Switch) was present in actions_html but completely unwired in canvas_js.
Stepper increment and decrement buttons (▲ and ▼) with class '.stepper-btn' were present in steppers_html but unwired in canvas_js.
Unwired action button (#btn_trigger_discharge) and stepper increment/decrement buttons (.stepper-btn)
Observation table column count mismatch: 9 data cells recorded vs 8 table header columns due to extraneous humidity cell
Unwired auto-focus action button ('btn_autofocus_meniscus'): Added click handler to automatically synchronize traveling microscope carriage height with the elevated meniscus position.

Unwired stepper controls: Added event listeners to stepper up/down buttons ('.stepper-btn-up', '.stepper-btn-down') to increment and decrement target numeric inputs within bounds and dispatch input/change events.

Observation table column mismatch: Fixed record handler which previously output 9 misaligned columns with unlisted parameters and missing B²; properly aligned row generation with the 7 headers defined in observation_thead_html.

Canvas numbered badges mismatched with legend pills: Remapped badges 1 through 7 to point to their corresponding components matching the canonical legend pills order (1: Lab Bench, 2: DC Power Supply, 3: Electromagnet, 4: U-Tube, 5: Liquid Column & Meniscus, 6: Traveling Microscope, 7: Gaussmeter).
Malformed mass susceptibility unit: Corrected inverted unit '/m³kg' to 'm³/kg' in readouts_html and observation_thead_html.

Observation table column misalignment: observation_thead_html defined 6 columns (Applied Voltage, Depth of Cut, Electrolyte Concentration, Current Density, Total Current, Material Removal Rate), but btnRecord recorded 9 columns with extra unheaded columns for row index, spindle speed, and electrolyte delivery pressure.

Corrupted Greek letter psi in apparatus_html, principles_summary_html, and validation_html: pressure specifications rendered psi as <math><mrow><mi>ψ</mi></mrow></math> instead of the English engineering pressure unit 'psi'.

Mangled MathML units in readouts_html, observation_thead_html, and principles_list_html: Current density was formatted as A/m m² instead of A/mm², Material Removal Rate was formatted as m/m³ s instead of mm³/s, and molar units were split as g/m ol and C/m ol.
Malformed data-unit attributes in readouts_html: data-unit attributes contained nested unescaped tags and quotes breaking HTML attribute syntax.
Live telemetry overwriting DOM units: updateTelemetryDOM queried val_reading_* container and directly overwrote textContent, erasing the MathML unit elements on each frame.

Unwired stepper controls: .stepper-btn-up and .stepper-btn-down arrow buttons lacked click event listeners to increment or decrement control values.
Unwired top-panel controls and reset: #btnReset, #btnToggle, #btnStep, and #experimentSelect lacked event listeners in canvas_js.

Leader line distance constraint violation (Q23, Q24): Leader line lengths for Badges 1-6 exceeded the [48, 80] px bounds specified in zoom_config_json (measuring 94–160 px); callout badge coordinates were adjusted to strictly respect the [48, 80] px bounds.
Canvas mouse interaction lock (Q22): Added pointer-events: none on #simCanvas to ensure interaction exclusively through Section 05 controls.
